part1.instructions: Read each short text carefully. Choose the best answer, A, B or C.

pages.stimulusHtml:
Hi Sara,

Mum is taking us to the park at 10.00 a.m. on Sunday. Please bring your blue ball. I will bring sandwiches.

Amir
pages.question: What should Sara bring?

pages.stimulusHtml:
FAMILY DAY
Saturday, 5 September · 9.00 a.m.–1.00 p.m.
School field
Bring a hat and water. Games start at 9.30 a.m.
pages.question: The poster is written to

options.A: invite families to a school event.

pages.question: Which statement is true?
A family arrives at 10.30 a.m. What is the next activity?

pages.stimulusHtml:
PICNIC AREA RULES
  • Keep food covered.
  • Do not feed the animals.
  • Take photos only from the marked line.
pages.question: Which action is allowed?

options.C: Taking photos from the marked line

pages.stimulusHtml: Family Day moved indoors after heavy rain began at noon. Students continued with board games in the school hall.
pages.question: Why did the students move indoors?

pages.stimulusHtml:
Dear Hana,

Grandpa is 70 on Saturday. Please arrive at 6.30 p.m. We will eat at 7.30 p.m. Bring a family photo for the memory book.

Love, Sara
pages.question: When will the family eat?

pages.stimulusHtml:
Amir left his football at home. Sara has a ball, but she is using it with her sister until 11.00 a.m.

Amir: “I will wait and play with them after 11.00 a.m.”
pages.question: What will Amir probably do?

options.A: Play football with Sara and her sister after 11.00 a.m.
